title: Demont's Place
wikitext:
[[File:Demont's Place.jpg|thumb|300px|Demont's Place.]]

'''Demont's Place''' lies just west of [[Moonbrook]] in [[Westfall]]. Like the [[Dead Acre]], little remains of the original [[farm]]stead. While no mechanical [[harvester]]s patrol the area, it is crawling with agents of the [[Defias Brotherhood]].
